title: STILL PRESENT (r3): the wrong-person awaiting UPDATE executed by the handler is still the unguarded update_reference_call_status — the taken_over_at backstop is never wired (TOCTOU open)
evidence: form_handler.gleam:1235 `case row.taken_over_at != "" {` ... 1250-1257 `sql.update_reference_call_status(config.db, id_uuid, sql.AwaitingCorrection, "", "contact_invalid", sql.ContactInitiated)`; update_reference_call_status.sql:23-24 `WHERE id = $1` / `  AND status = $5::reference_call_status` (no taken_over_at clause); mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person.sql:16 `  AND taken_over_at IS NULL` (guarded, but grep finds no src caller outside the generated module); race pin reference_checks_actions_integration_test.gleam:1743-1746 drives do_take_over then calls `rc_sql.mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person(db, call)` DIRECTLY, not the POST route
detail: The executed awaiting transition still guards only on status; the read-time check at 1235 leaves the TOCTOU window (take-over never changes status, so the guard still matches). The race pin is vacuous — neutralizing the backstop in the executed UPDATE turns nothing red.
recommended_fix: Wire apply_wrong_person's awaiting branch to mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person (0-row -> stand down); rewrite the race test to drive POST /reference/:token/wrong-person through handle_wrong_person_post so it bites when the backstop is removed.
